description: Update an outbound webhook endpoint's name, URL, subscribed events, or status (enabled/disabled). Providing events replaces the existing event list. Sequenzy disables an endpoint automatically after every delivery fails for 7 days (autoDisabledAt is set); enabling it or changing its URL clears that state.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

status.description: Enable or disable deliveries to this endpoint.

url.description: New HTTPS URL that will receive webhook events.

name: update_webhook

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `update_webhook` MCP tool.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.

webhook.description: The outbound webhook record returned by Sequenzy.
